Orange Lantern Corps

Larfleeze

Bearer of the orange light of avarice.

Larfleeze is the possessive bearer of the orange light of avarice. Agent Orange introduces his corner of the spectrum and the unusual army surrounding him.

Continuity: Main DC comics continuity; this profile follows the cited era rather than asserting a permanent present-day status.

Affiliation
Orange Lantern Corps
First appearance
Green Lantern (2005) #25 (2007; January 2008 cover date), cameo
Story history — History and later developments — spoilers

Larfleeze’s Corps differs from an organization of independent recruits: its orange figures are constructs formed from stolen identities. That distinction matters when meeting Glomulus. His desire to acquire more brings conflict with other Corps and makes alliances unstable. Follow Agent Orange into the Green Lantern chapters of Blackest Night and Brightest Day for his spectrum-ensemble role.
